Lists registered external MCP servers: connection status, authorization state (only whether a token exists, never its value), tool counts and the latest issue. Read-only, no network.

Registers and connects an external MCP server by URL (outbound connection, always asks once): name auto-derived, OAuth and transport probed; opens the authorization page automatically when needed, once only. Name is optional.
Connects / reconnects / refreshes a registered MCP server: while connected it re-pulls the tool list and reports additions/removals; opens the authorization page once if required.
Disconnects a MCP server: unregisters its tools, deletes the local token from the vault and disables startup auto-connect. Config is kept; it can be reconnected later. Asks every time.
Stores a user-provided access token into the token vault (Keystore-encrypted). The token is never echoed, logged or backed up; for pre-issued (PAT) servers. Asks every time.
Clipboard is empty: copy the token first, then tap Read on the "%1$s" row.
Clipboard does not look like a token (too long, or contains spaces/newlines); the vault for "%1$s" was not touched.
Token for "%1$s" was not stored: retry, or use the authorization page.
"%1$s" is no longer in the list; clipboard was not read.
Token for "%1$s" is in the vault; clipboard cleared.
Token for "%1$s" is in the vault; clipboard could not be cleared — please clear it manually.
This message may contain a token: it will stay in the chat history. Prefer "Read from clipboard" on the MCP server row.
